name: Petra Lindqvist
bio: Scout by preference and by temperament. Lindqvist has never fired first at anything and has never been fired at twice.

personality.label: Cool observer
personality.description: Prefers a clear view to a grand entrance. Wry, measured and difficult to rattle.

move: Moving. No need to announce the visit.
attack: I have seen enough. Taking the shot.
guard: A good view from here. I will keep it.
investigate: I will see what the return is hiding.
heavy_fire: They have noticed me. I would like a change of scenery.
Too much fire on this position. Cover my next move.
